lines: Kitchen's backed up ten minutes, the fryer's confused, and I already know what you're going to order.
Third time this summer. Nobody's paying with a card until the register wakes up, so keep it in cash or in tabs.
So. Third brownout this summer, and it's not getting better on its own. What's this room actually going to do about it?

choices.text: We organize. Actual meetings, actual people, actual pressure on somebody who can fix this.
We keep an eye on each other and figure it out as it comes. No committees.
We wait. Maybe it doesn't happen a fourth time.
Honestly? Not my fight. I just want my lights back.
